title: Taiwan Detects 4 PLA Aircraft Sorties, 3 Crossing into Central/Southwestern/Eastern ADIZ
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 4 PLA aircraft sorties, 7 PLAN vessels and 4 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) September 21, 2026; 3 of the 4 sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the central, southwestern and eastern ADIZ sectors. Taiwan's armed forces responded with CAP aircraft, navy ships and coastal missile systems. The tally held at the low end of the post-Jioupeng-drill range for a second straight day after the sharp pullback from the Sept 18 window high (28 sorties, 24 crossing), even as naval and coast-guard presence stayed elevated relative to early September.

title: Trump Set for Washington Summit With Xi as $14B Taiwan Arms Package Remains Pending
detail: With Chinese President Xi Jinping's three-day Washington state visit set to open September 23, 2026 and formal talks and a state dinner scheduled for September 24, US and Taiwanese officials braced for a summit one analyst dubbed 'the summit of the three Ts: Taiwan, technology and trade.' The $14 billion US arms package for Taiwan — paused since Trump and Xi's May 2026 Beijing meeting — remained unresolved heading into the visit; Trump had previously described Taiwan arms sales as a 'very good negotiating chip' with China, while Beijing continued to call Taiwan 'the most important issue in China-US relations.' China's rare-earth export-control suspension, also agreed at the Beijing meeting, is separately set to expire November 10. The White House was expected to maintain its longstanding position of strategic ambiguity rather than make new Taiwan commitments during the visit.
